what: Handle SongSelect chart structures in the WorshipTools import

introduction.message:
Handle SongSelect chart structures in the WorshipTools import

Real charts use variant sections (Chorus 1A/1B), wordless repeat
sections (Verse 1 Repeat), jump cues, first/second endings, chord only
bar rows and a multi-line footer.

- Drop the variant letter and title-case upper case headings so Free
  Show finds the group (and its colour); variants stay separate sections
- "Verse 1 Repeat" with no words adds the earlier section again
- Remove chord only sections and bar rows, jump cues such as
  "(To Bridge 1b)" and "(Last x)", and duplicate endings
- Keep footer lines apart and filter licence text out of the author

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

latestEdit.message:
Add WorshipTools import to Add show

Add a fourth option to the Add show popup that opens an embedded
WorshipTools Music Stand (persistent session). After signing in and
opening a service, the songs are listed in service order; the chosen
songs are read one at a time (lyrics and section tags only, no chords)
and each is created as its own show.

- Embedded WebContentsView with a read-only preload and a DOM extractor
  for the service menu and rendered charts (multi-page charts supported)
- Directions in the chart are interpreted: x2 and "Repeat Chorus" repeat
  sections, instrumental parts are removed, other directions go to notes
- Same lines per slide / auto groups / format controls as Quick lyrics,
  now shared through LyricsFormatOptions
- Destination: library only, or library and open project (service order)
- Songs that already exist in the library are skipped by default
- Tests: text builder, extractor in a real browser, and a real Electron
  run against a local mock Music Stand page

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

what: Keep linked slides together when stepping, add a debug panel, stop the project view flashing

introduction.message:
Keep linked slides together when stepping, add a debug panel, stop the project view flashing

Linked slides
- A linked card shares one next slide timer and moves on as one slide
  (timer, Space, arrows). Outputs wait for each other while one still has
  lines/reveals left. The half of a card that gets no new slide is cleared
  (slide only, the background is remembered).
- Going past the last slide plays the next show straight away instead of
  only selecting it; shows without slides are skipped; the project view no
  longer scrolls away. An output without slides in a show, or that ran out
  of its own, no longer pushes the project on while another output is still
  in the show. Quick change back (arrow keys) still only selects.

Project view
- No more flash when the project moves on: the played flag no longer
  reloads the list, and the old list stays on screen while it reloads.

Debug panel (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+L)
- Live state plus a copyable log in tabs (keys & navigation, outputs,
  output windows, control panel), a copy button per tab and Copy all.
  Also records the output windows and bursts of rebuilt elements.

Tests replay real projects against the real navigation code.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

why:
Fork decision: “Keep linked slides together when stepping, add a debug panel, stop the project view flashing

Linked slides
- A linked card shares one next slide timer and moves on as one slide
  (timer, Space, arrows). Outputs wait for each other while one still has
  lines/reveals left. The half of a card that gets no new slide is cleared
  (slide only, the background is remembered).
- Going past the last slide plays the next show straight away instead of
  only selecting it; shows without slides are skipped; the project view no
  longer scrolls away. An output without slides in a show, or that ran out
  of its own, no longer pushes the project on while another output is still
  in the show. Quick change back (arrow keys) still only selects.

Project view
- No more flash when the project moves on: the played flag no longer
  reloads the list, and the old list stays on screen while it reloads.

Debug panel (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+L)
- Live state plus a copyable log in tabs (keys & navigation, outputs,
  output windows, control panel), a copy button per tab and Copy all.
  Also records the output windows and bursts of rebuilt elements.

Tests replay real projects against the real navigation code.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>”

Root cause: Browser's 'slow network' intervention causes text to render with fallback fonts (Arial) before custom fonts (CMGSans) finish loading. Autosize measured dimensions with wrong font, resulting in incorrect font sizes on first load.

Solution:
- Added await document.fonts.ready before measuring dimensions
- Added dimension stability check with adaptive timing (100-150ms initial wait, then 20-50ms intervals)

what: Phase 4: fix regressions found while checking the running app

introduction.message:
Phase 4: fix regressions found while checking the running app

- Output slide changes stacked every previous slide on the output. Svelte 5
  revives a {#key} branch when the same key value returns while the old branch
  is still fading out; SlideContent/Overlay toggle {#key show} true -> false ->
  true, so the old SlideItemTransition (with all its accumulated states) came
  back. Key on a counter that changes with every show change instead, which is
  what Svelte 3 did. Compared against a Svelte 3 build: text fades, removal of
  the old slide, rapid presses, clear and image/video backgrounds now match.
- server bundles: Vite 8 no longer polyfills import.meta.url in IIFE output, so
  the dev builds (watchServers / build:servers:dev) of stage and remote threw
  "Invalid URL" for new URL("/import-logos/...", import.meta.url). Define it
  as document.baseURI.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

what: Phase 2: required code changes for Svelte 5 (legacy mode)

introduction.message:
Phase 2: required code changes for Svelte 5 (legacy mode)

- mount(App, { target }) instead of new App({ target }) in the 6 entry points
  (frontend/main.ts and server/{cam,controller,output_stream,remote,stage}/main.ts)
- add |global to every existing transition:/in:/out: directive (42), including
  the custom transition helper, so transitions keep playing when a parent block
